cc:Work.dc:title: Which harmonised standard for which industrial product (our assessment)
cc:Work.dc:creator: Steffen Zimmermann

svg.text: Which harmonised standard for which industrial product (our assessment)
Machinery and industrial automation products, as of 27 Nov 2026; our own assessment, not legal advice.
Harmonised standards for the essential cybersecurity requirements (Annex I CRA)
EN 50742 amendment with Annex ZB, not started
EN IEC 62443-3-3, not started, with -4-1 as reference
EN IEC 62443-4-2, with -4-1 as normative reference
EN IEC 62443-4-2, with -4-1 as normative reference
EN IEC 62443-4-2, with -4-1 as normative reference
EN ISO 24882:2027 (prEN ISO 24882), Part I and II
EN ISO 24882:2027 amendment with Annex ZB, not started
Citation in the Official Journal not foreseen, or not under M/606: no presumption of conformity
Citation in the Official Journal considered, presumption of conformity not confirmed
Citation in the Official Journal foreseen: presumption of conformity
Part II only: presumption for vulnerability handling (Annex I Part II) through EN 40000-1-3, not for the product requirements of Part I.
EN 40000-1-2: the Commission considers citing it without presumption of conformity. EN 40000-1-4: citation not foreseen.
EN 50742:2026 (Machinery Regulation, M/605) is not in standardisation request M/606; its amendment with an Annex ZB for the CRA has not started.
EN IEC 62443: the European versions with their CENELEC amendments under M/606. EN IEC 62443-4-2 is the candidate for citation, with -4-1
as normative reference (no citation of its own foreseen). * If the scope of -4-2 does not fit the intended purpose of the product: no presumption for Part I.
EN ISO 24882 is not in M/606; its amendment with an Annex ZB is expected as a harmonised standard under the next standardisation request.
(1) Full presumption if cited in time; Part II only if cited after 11 December 2027, which is currently most likely.
** Class II: the harmonised standard applied by the manufacturer and assessed by the notified body.
Class I: Module A only where cited harmonised standards covering all requirements of Annex I are fully applied; otherwise B+C or H for the rest.
Sources: CRA, M/606 and the CEN-CENELEC work programme; our own assessment.
